biz_maps_success_hero_subtitle: Thanks for submitting your business. We'll list you on Bitcoin merchant maps shortly.
biz_maps_success_timeline_c1: Your business will be listed on BTC Map and other Bitcoin merchant directories within 2 to 4 weeks. We review each submission by hand to keep the maps accurate.
biz_maps_success_timeline_c2: Once your listing is live, Bitcoiners nearby can find your business and come spend Bitcoin there.
biz_maps_success_view_c1: While you wait, take a look at BTC Map to see the growing network of businesses that accept Bitcoin around the world.
